name: delivered context
wording: A bounded context cratylus ships as the practice a project's agents work by: the current design of one of cratylus's own contexts at release, placed read-only under the owned root with its origin, version and identity. It is never part of a project's design: shown apart from the project's contexts, still read first by a fresh session, never in the project's context map, never written into its journal. A project whose journal holds that same context, by the entry that first recorded it, reads its own instead, as part of its design.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
